description: Upload bytes to AFG's content-addressed store (POST /v1/artifacts, signed). Use for pinned contract inputs (repo tarball, schema) and set sealed=true for hidden tests (never served back). Max 2 MiB. Returns sha256 and afg-cas:// uri. TEST MONEY ONLY: mock ledger, test tokens (tUSDC), no real funds.

SignedRequestIn.description: A request you signed locally (bring-your-own-wallet mode).

body.description: The exact JSON body that was hashed into the message.
body.title: Body

headers.description: Exactly the four headers X-AFG-Address, X-AFG-Timestamp, X-AFG-Nonce, X-AFG-Signature (EIP-191 personal_sign over the signing_message).
headers.title: Headers

SignedRequestIn.title: SignedRequestIn

address.description: Bring-your-own-wallet mode: your wallet address. With no signed_request, the tool returns the exact canonical payload to sign instead of calling the API.
address.title: Address

signed_request.description: Bring-your-own-wallet mode: the request you signed locally (headers + body). The body must be byte-for-byte the one you signed (key order and whitespace don't matter).

wallet_handle.description: Session wallet handle from afg_create_wallet (TEST ONLY). Omit when signing locally.
wallet_handle.title: Wallet Handle
